text.predictions: Every series and token shown is a MODEL PREDICTION (size, lens, angle, framing, light, composition, movement) or an unverified Phase 1/2 heuristic (shot starts, length, key, DoF, people, sound, palette) whose accuracy on this film is UNMEASURED: no labels exist. Read the curves as what the model or heuristic tends to say, not as measurements of the film. Consistency is not correctness.
text.model: Static slots (size, lens, angle, framing, light, comp) are predicted by Qwen3-VL-4B with a LoRA adapter fine-tuned on ShotQA (Step C), the film pipeline's default since 2026-10-22 (pipeline version p3c-v2-4b); it replaced an earlier Qwen3-VL-2B adapter. On film-held-out ShotQA validation it scores 82.49% against 81.16% for the 2B (results/stepc/selection.md), but it was selected on that same set, and benchmark accuracy does not transfer to these films. Switching models changed many tokens (for example the lighting-condition slot of 574 of the 1,077 Night of the Living Dead shots): a change, not a proven improvement. Movement comes from the Phase 4 geometry model, which the switch did not change.
text.intervals: Mean-based series show 95% bootstrap intervals from resampling each window's shots (seed 0); median shot length shows its within-window interquartile range; the shot-start rate has no interval. Shots are not independent, so the intervals are likely too narrow, and none of them measures label accuracy. Shot starts per minute counts shot STARTS (including the first shot). Windows with fewer than 15 shots are flagged.
text.shapes: Within-film shapes only: each series is z-scored WITHIN its own film, so only the shape over each film's running time can be read. Levels are never compared across films (plan section 1.4); no similarity statistic, no pooled curve, no ranking of films.
text.similar: Shots like this: the other shots of THIS film whose token rows are most similar (docs/similar_shots_spec.md: per-slot matches, equal weights, `*` values count half). This is similarity of PREDICTED tokens whose accuracy is UNMEASURED, not ground truth: it does not mean the shots look alike or that the film-makers intended a callback. The shot itself and its two neighbours on each side are never listed.
text.movement_generic: Movement sets are INFLATED: many predicted sets are contradictory (an opposite pair such as pan-left with pan-right, or `static` together with another atom), which no real camera move produces. Read them as the model's tendencies, never as camera work, and never compare movement levels across films.
text.explorer: Every series and token shown is a MODEL PREDICTION (size, lens, angle, framing, light, composition, movement) or an unverified Phase 1/2 heuristic (shot starts, length, key, DoF, people, sound, palette) whose accuracy on this film is UNMEASURED: no labels exist. Read the curves as what the model or heuristic tends to say, not as measurements of the film. Consistency is not correctness. A * marks an attribute whose start/mid/end keyframes give different predictions.
text.compare_info: The side-by-side view needs two listed films with a v1 token table. Public mode lists only films marked public domain in the committed film registry, and only 1 such film is available here (Night of the Living Dead (1968)), so there is nothing to compare it with. Its within-film arc is on the Film overview page.

slot_help: shot size, how big the subject is in the frame: ECU, CU, MCU, MS, MWS, WS, EWS (extreme close-up to extreme wide)
lens class: long, medium, wide, ultra-wide
camera angle: low, high, overhead, aerial, dutch (there is no eye-level class)
what is framed: single, insert, 2-shot, 3-shot, group, establishing, ots (over the shoulder)
light type / light condition, e.g. daylight/soft or artificial/high-contrast
composition: center, balanced, symmetrical, right-heavy, left-heavy, short-side
brightness key from the luminance histogram: low-key, mid-key, high-key
depth of field: shallow, medium, deep
number of people detected (4+ for four or more)
dominant sound: score, dialogue, ambient, silence
colour palette cluster id g00-g31 (32 global clusters)
set of predicted camera-movement atoms joined with + (e.g. pan-left+push-in); static alone = no movement
marker_help: low confidence: the start, mid and end keyframes of the shot give different predictions for this slot
missing: no value for this shot (e.g. a shot absent from the movement table)
not available: the film has no movement table
